meta.title: Konoba Riba Ribi Grize Rep — seafood restaurant in Novi Sad
meta.description: Fresh fish, seafood and Dalmatian cooking in Novi Sad, Serbia. Bulevar cara Lazara 46. Reservations: +381 21 644 2922. Rated 4.8 ★ on Google.
meta.ogAlt: Konoba Riba Ribi Grize Rep — logo and seafood

hero.slogan: Where every bite chases the next.
hero.sub: Fresh fish, the Adriatic on your plate and a glass of Malvasia — on Bulevar cara Lazara.

about.label: The Konoba
about.title: The sea, unhurried.
about.lead: Riba Ribi Grize Rep is a konoba where everything revolves around the sea: fresh fish, shellfish and seafood, cooked the Dalmatian and Mediterranean way — the grill, olive oil, a few herbs and nothing more.
about.text: A glass of wine, usually white, comes with every plate, and the evening moves at the pace of a seaside promenade. Our staff speak several languages, so neighbours and travellers from afar feel equally at home.
about.p1: Choose it from the display and we’ll cook it the way you like — whole or filleted.
about.p2: Dalmatian and Mediterranean plates: the grill, buzara, crepulja, olive oil.
about.p3: Staff who speak several languages and are happy to tell you what’s best today.

kitchen.label: From the kitchen
kitchen.title: From the grill, from the sea
kitchen.intro: The dishes our guests choose most often — and a few we warmly recommend to begin with.
kitchen.plataD: Prawns, squid and fish from the grill, with asparagus and olive oil.
kitchen.fileD: White fish fillet with cherry tomatoes and sauce.
kitchen.brusketeD: With smoked salmon, and with salt cod “na belo” — with a glass of Malvasia.
kitchen.pasteD: Squid ink, clams, prawns “na buzaru” — and a sunset on the terrace.
kitchen.kapesanteD: Baked in the shell. Our guests recommend them to start the evening.
kitchen.hobotnicaD: Simply grilled — one of our guests’ most-ordered dishes.
kitchen.lignjeD: Simply grilled, with young Swiss chard.
kitchen.rizotoD: Squid ink — dark and rich, like the sea at night.
kitchen.tunaD: In a sesame crust, on greens.
kitchen.ulje: Fish in warm olive oil with clams
kitchen.uljeD: For two, with rosemary and cherry tomatoes.

catch.label: The catch
catch.title: The catch display
catch.text: Pick your whole fish yourself, fresh from the display. It is priced per kilogram and, if you like, we fillet it right in front of you.
catch.note: Price per kilogram. The final price depends on the weight of the fish you choose.

menu.label: Menu
menu.title: Menu
menu.footnote: Prices are in Serbian dinars (RSD). Weights are approximate.

wine.label: Wine
wine.title: Malvasia
wine.lead: The white wine of the Adriatic coast — fresh, golden, with a herbal note. A natural match for fish, shellfish and bruschetta.
wine.text: Here Malvasia isn’t only in the glass: its sauce goes into our sea bass and bream fillet, and the chicken medallions.
wine.quote: We highly recommend to start with scallops and also order malvazija vino, it is amazing!
